integrity_checks.ranking_metrics_note: Saved AUC/AP are carried through, not re-estimated from probabilities in this aggregate-only calculation.

limitations: The original joint screen remains INFEASIBLE: only six of ten source selections qualified. Conditional six-seed improvements cannot replace that endpoint.
All findings here were summarized after outcomes. The eight weight/model arms were frozen before fitting; favorable posthoc contrasts among them are not newly preregistered hypotheses.
All source evaluation partitions were exposed in earlier development; no independent confirmatory holdout or incident-level confidence claim.
Repeated seeds do not create independent test incidents. No p-values, confidence bounds, causal deployment claim or corrected multiple-comparison claim is supplied.
No model, threshold, label, outcome or success criterion was changed for this calculation. No future-test model is selected by these summaries.
No novel algorithm or universally superior model is established. More benign fitting labels are an unequal-label-budget comparison, not a matched-budget architecture comparison.
Precision, F1 and alert workload reflect this constructed dataset prevalence, not a production SOC forecast.
External DEDALE remains a controls-only stress result from one execution; it does not validate the constrained candidate.

primary_gate.reason: All prespecified seeds must have a selected policy; no averaging only feasible survivors

prior_benign_label_allocation.scope: Earlier frozen strong-control comparison on the same previously exposed original development test: 30,787 unique rows, 29,929 normal and 858 attack including 144 lateral. This is a different training comparison and must not be spliced into the current verification contrast.

scope.aggregation: Arithmetic mean across the named seeds. Relative FP reduction is 100*(1-mean_FP_A/mean_FP_B), not mean of seedwise percentages. All direction counts compare the same seed. Unique evaluation rows repeat across seeds; counts across seeds are not independent incidents.

label_ledger.interpretation: Label-based support sampling and splits access the larger known-label pool; allocated fitting labels are not total acquisition cost. All evaluation rows already exposed in earlier work.

scope.metric_definition: Stage alert recall means an attack-stage row is routed as any attack. Exact-stage recall means its six-class argmax names the correct stage. These are distinct.
